findings.description: Direct sit and crouch renders show the front apron still displaced behind the lap; fitted shorts remain exposed across the seated thighs. The pose-matched diagnostic measures overskirt upper-thigh coverage at 30.8% left / 28.8% right in sit and 40.5% / 40.2% in crouch, while shorts cover 95.5% / 95.4%. The v20 front-panel extension/projection improved these readings only modestly and did not retain front lap drape.

Neutral, turntable and pose views still show irregular coarse/faceted folds instead of controlled sewn pleats. The added front apron does not form a coherent lap-facing panel in sit; a long triangular side/rear portion hangs behind the bent legs.
The back view still does not clearly reveal an attached rear adjustment tab or buckle; the feature remains low-contrast and nearly flush with the waist/skirt seam.
Jacket seam trim and elbow quilting remain faint against the mostly plain ivory surface, and the outfit still lacks the intended fencing-set detail definition.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V20 retained the v19 weight profile and added 60 mm hem extension plus 25 mm forward projection to the two front overskirt panels. Direct inspection of five views and six poses shows the apron still kicked behind the lap in sit/crouch; measured upper-thigh overskirt coverage is 28.8-30.8% sitting and 40.2-40.5% crouching versus 95.4-95.5% shorts coverage. The panel-pattern change was insufficient. Coarse folds, weak rear-tab/jacket details persist.

nextAction: REJECT. Keep the garment as an unapproved prototype. Do not repeat front hem lengthening/projection or hem-weight tuning: v20 directly failed to form a lap-facing overskirt, with only 28.8-30.8% sit and 40.2-40.5% crouch upper-thigh coverage versus 95.4-95.5% shorts. Change the pattern architecture so the front overskirt has a seated lap panel joined to the side/rear panels with explicit sewn boundaries and controlled pleat allowance; preserve opaque fitted shorts. Then build through the normal pipeline and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Reduce irregular faceting, make the rear tab and buckle visibly attached, strengthen jacket seam/elbow detailing, and author UVs from the current mesh before UV acceptance. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
